name: Snapped: Killer Couples
description: This extension of the long-running true-crime series 'Snapped' shifts the focus to couples whose passion drives them to commit terrible criminal acts. Using re-creations and gripping firsthand accounts, each episode takes a deep dive into a case, telling the story of the couple's romance, how the relationship evolved from love to manipulation, and what ultimately drove the couple to commit the crime.

videos.title: Charles Chumbler and Michael Kariakis
videos.overview: The murder of a beloved schoolteacher takes detectives from Paducah, KY, to Florida where an unexpected romance comes to light; as the investigation unfolds, relationships unravel and a long con born of greed is unveiled.

videos.title: Liz Rogan and Tony DePuisaye-Greene
videos.overview: A small town in Washington is rocked after a local man is found shot to death in his home. Police wonder if his complicated love life played a role until a string of robberies exposes a dangerous couple with a more sinister motive.

videos.title: Susan and Blane Barksdale
videos.overview: An elderly veteran is nowhere to be found after his house suddenly bursts into flames in Tucson, Ariz., causing authorities to kickstart a nationwide manhunt to catch a desperate couple on the run not once, but twice.

videos.title: Xaveriana Cook and Hunter Carlstrom
videos.overview: We don't have a summary for Xaveriana Cook and Hunter Carlstrom yet. Hang in there, or go ahead and contribute one.

videos.title: Ellen Friar and Gavin MacFarlane
videos.overview: A father and daughter are reported missing after evidence of a bloody attack is found in their home. As the investigation unfolds, police interview a trio of suspects and their conflicting stories reveal a twisted plot driven by infatuation.

videos.title: Shayne Lovera and Brett Rae
videos.overview: A professor is found dead inside his Jeep in what appears to be a car accident in Tennessee; after evidence at the scene points to foul play, the ensuing investigation exposes secrets of infidelity and a crime motivated by lust and money.

videos.title: Shanika Robinson and Isiah Genus
videos.overview: An immigrant from Pakistan is found brutally murdered inside his Washington, D.C., pizzeria; given the lack of forced entry, investigators believe he knew his killer and a plot involving marriage fraud surfaces, leading to a deadly crime of passion.

videos.title: Jennifer Bailey and Paul Henson
videos.overview: Texas police investigating the stabbing death of a mother uncover a bizarre scene: poisoned pudding, cell phones submerged in water, and a bathtub rigged for electrocution; in the end, a disturbing plan is revealed, driven by a young love gone wrong.

videos.title: Amanda Noverr and Adam Williams
videos.overview: When RV-lifestyle couple James and Michelle Butler go missing while camping along the southern coast of Texas, the discovery of human remains leads authorities to embark on an international manhunt to bring the fugitives to justice.

videos.title: Patricia Sexton and Michael Fielding
videos.overview: After a father is reported missing, a body is discovered in a remote Texan swamp. Investigators are faced with several possible suspects as complex family dynamics come into play that expose a secret betrayal.

videos.title: Brenda Dixon and Elbert Holder
videos.overview: Just one month before her wedding, a nurse is shot to death in a reported roadside robbery in rural Arkansas. As investigators work to find the suspects, odd details of the attack are uncovered and a confession paints an entirely different story.

videos.title: Crystal Brinson and Byron Boutin
videos.overview: Hunters stumble across a young woman's decaying body wrapped in fabric, launching an investigation across several counties in Florida; horrific rumors quickly swirl and a night of partying that morphed into an act of desperation is revealed.

videos.title: Patricia Aldridge and Mitchell Vickers
videos.overview: After Evidence of a violent attack is discovered in a West Virginia home, the body of a beloved photojournalist is found in the woods; the search for the killer reveals a sordid affair and a murder-for-hire plot with a shocking co-conspirator.

videos.title: Monica Diaz and Michael Naranjo
videos.overview: In the Los Angeles suburbs, a family is brutally attacked in its residence, leaving four dead and a mother clinging to life; as police search for answers, suspicion grows closer to home and unveils a macabre obsession fueled by young love.

videos.title: Maya Maxwell and Cedric Marks
videos.overview: After two best friends are reported missing, Texas and Minnesota police team up to bring a suspected serial killer to justice. An accomplice shares her side of the story from behind bars, revealing chilling details of the crime.

videos.title: Cynthia and Richie Wilder
videos.overview: C.J. Wynn, author of a novel about the case, says that Cynthia and Richie Wilder have not expressed remorse for the murder of Angila Wilder.

videos.title: Alison Martin and Justin Terpstra
videos.overview: Authorities respond to a car fire and find a charred body discarded nearby

videos.title: Laura Martin and Robert Quinn
videos.overview: Just months before his retirement, a missing trucker's body is found in a remote creek; as detectives run out of leads, a seemingly minute detail breathes new life into the investigation revealing two lovers with a nefarious plot.

videos.title: Angelita Reyes and Jesus Jeronimo
videos.overview: When an esteemed California pastor is found executed in an almond orchard, investigators turn to his complex love life for answers.

videos.title: Adrienne Simpson and Tyler Terry
videos.overview: When a crime spree leaves five dead, South Carolina authorities kick start a multi-state investigation to capture a desperate couple on the run.

videos.title: Holly Elkins and Andrew Beard
videos.overview: After a young mother is murdered in broad daylight, Texas authorities are on a hunt for a masked gunman.

videos.title: Brinlee Denison and Nicholas Johnson
videos.overview: A welfare check confirms the worst when a woman is found brutally murdered on her couch.

videos.title: Raquel Garajau and Joseph Villani
videos.overview: When a missing man’s bullet-riddled body is found off the side of a road, police must dig into his complicated past to uncover the truth.

videos.title: Ashley Coleman and Hakeem Griffin-White
videos.overview: When a shocking crime is committed in broad daylight that leaves a young man dead on the street, the investigation uncovers a personal vendetta. In exclusive prison interviews, the killer couple will each share their version of events.

videos.title: Amanda Lothery and Rajhi "T.C." Render
videos.overview: When a young soldier goes missing just two days after his wedding, authorities fear the worst has occurred in their small Ohio town.

videos.title: Anna Schroeder and Rachel Helm
videos.overview: A house fire in a small town in Illinois ignites a homicide investigation after a mother's body is found in her bedroom.

videos.title: Michelle Hetzel and Brandon Bloss
videos.overview: After a teen girl is found dead in the backseat of her own car, detectives focus on the complicated relationships between the victim and the two girls who discovered her body.

videos.title: Devonnee And Malik Wilkerson
videos.overview: A woman's lifeless body is rushed to a hospital in New York after two strangers found her unconscious at a subway station.

videos.title: Melissa Schafer and William Baer
videos.overview: This episode uncovers the harrowing story of a successful businessman who was murdered in his garage during a robbery, witnessed by none other than his wife.

videos.title: Christina Araujo and Zach Abell
videos.overview: After years of being independent in Miami, 31-year-old property manager Aileen Seiden was living happily when she reconnected with an old friend from High School, Zachary Abell.

videos.title: Casandra Nazario And Miles Johnson
videos.overview: When a nurse's aide disappears without a trace, detectives learn she was entangled in a complex love triangle. After a tragic discovery in the woods, the investigation points to a sordid affair and a jealous lover looking for revenge.

videos.title: Linda Buckner and Walter Renz
videos.overview: When authorities learn an Ohio woman has been missing for nearly half a year, all signs point to foul play.

videos.title: Elsa Segura and Lyndon Wiggins
videos.overview: When a Minneapolis realtor is murdered after an attempt on her boyfriend's life, authorities believe the heinous crimes are connected.

videos.title: Raminder Kaur and Baldeo Taneja
videos.overview: When a beloved woman is gunned down in the street near her home, details of a bitter divorce encompass the investigation.
